method: Own SN likelihoods (numpy, from the public files), chi2 profiled over the magnitude offset
text: Fidelity gate. chi2 of the Planck LCDM cosmology (Omega_m = 0.3135): 1259.6 (Pantheon+) and 1644.68 (DES5Y). LCDM fits: Pantheon+ Omega_m = 0.333 +- 0.018, chi2 1258.4, Delta chi2 = 1.2 vs Planck; DES5Y Omega_m = 0.354 +- 0.017 (text) / 0.349 (Fig. 1 best fit), chi2 1639.6, Delta chi2 = 5.1.
rests_on: The statements 'Pantheon+ consistent with Planck LCDM' and 'DES5Y discrepant' (abstract) rest on these fits; reproducing them makes our SN likelihoods speak for the paper (G15)
